certified_invariants: The bridge reads authoritative durable HealthControlState; callers cannot supply a self-authorizing health object.
Automatic health synchronization is monotone and can only maintain or tighten risk: HEALTHY maps to NORMAL, DEGRADED to REDUCED, QUARANTINED/RETIRED to NO_NEW_RISK.
Stricter-state-wins applies across strategy and optional portfolio controls; missing/stale/future required control state fails closed.
Bridge state is durable, baseline/policy bound, replay-idempotent and protected by raw-row SHA-256 commitment plus semantic validation.
Every distinct bridge state change atomically increments safety_state.version, invalidating already-approved RiskDecision objects before OMS submission.
OMS independently rechecks the bridge at submit time, closing the temporal gap where a health control can become stale without a state-version mutation.

Automatic controls never increase risk budgets or exposure. True risk-reducing exits remain available under REDUCED/NO_NEW_RISK when the Capital Safety Kernel independently classifies them as reducing.

Recovery is never automatic: it requires explicit acknowledgement, fresh authoritative health evidence under the same baseline/policy binding, and relaxes at most one bridge level per acknowledgement.
Safety/OMS integration is explicit opt-in at bootstrap; default historical paper-core behavior remains bridge-disabled.
No bridge operation submits broker orders or bypasses Capital Safety Kernel/OMS.
